newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Klabin begun as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Klabin begun as buy.

text.p: -- Banco Patrimonio/Salomon Brothers said it has begun coverage of Brazilian pulp and paper firm Klabin with a buy recommendation.
-- "Our opinion is based on the company's leading position in paper production in Brazil, the stock's valuation, and the company's likely earnings growth," the bank said in a report.
-- Higher earnings are expected to come from an up-cycle in pulp prices expected to begin in 1997's second half and peak in 1998, the bank said.
-- Patrimonio also said Brazilian paper output is expected to grow at a compound annual rate of 5.4 percent between 1996 and 2005 due to "extremely large pent-up demand in the country."
-- Klabin is Brazil's top integrated paper producer, with 1995 market pulp sales of 250,000 tons, and paper and paper product sales of 900,000 tons, it added.

-- At 1355 local/1055 EST on the Sao Paulo stock market, Klabin's preferred share was flat at its Tuesday close of 0.99 reais, and its voting common was untraded at its November 14 closing price of 2.00 reais.
